patch_description: This uses LP bottleneck information to generate focused moves, but replaces the existing archive-driven batch search with an annealed walk and target-directed path relinking. Relinking attempts degree-preserving exchanges that add edges from a different elite network, helping the walk cross between promising regions. A small, diverse LP-scored archive supplies both parents and relinking targets. The move mix adapts from LP-confirmed improvements, while surrogate energy only helps rank proposals rather than deciding which networks are good.
